atlas-gr.0182: High-street banks ask for extensive paperwork; an authorised institution with a Greek IBAN, such as Viva.com, is a quicker start.
atlas-gr.0183: Nothing to renew: the EU registration certificate does not expire.
atlas-gr.0184: The application receipt makes your stay legal only inside Greece: with an expired D visa, do not change planes in a Schengen airport. You may leave and return only by a direct route to a non-Schengen country, and only while the yearly ministry circular allows it.
atlas-gr.0185: File the permit online before the last day of your D visa: late filing is refused and irregular stay is fined €600 to €1,200.
atlas-gr.0186: The online receipt is valid only in Greece: with an expired D visa, travel only on direct flights home, never through another Schengen airport.
atlas-gr.0187: Apostille the original document first, then have it translated in full, apostille included, by a certified Greek translator.
atlas-gr.0188: A paper lease has no value for immigration: the landlord registers it on Taxisnet and you accept it online with your tax number.
atlas-gr.0189: There are no online appointments for EU registration at Petrou Ralli in Athens: people queue from 4:30 in the morning for 20 to 30 numbers.
atlas-gr.0190: Immigration offices in Attica and Thessaloniki take far longer than the legal 60 days.
atlas-gr.0191: Travelling home on the receipt depends on a return circular renewed each year.
atlas-gr.0192: Some consulates charge students €90 for the D visa, others the standard €180.
atlas-gr.0193: Greek banks ask newcomers for a long paper trail.
